what: Offline re-run of /verify_tree (TreeChain::is_valid_tree) on each node's saved final blocks and PQP, with the fixed check: coinbase maturity and timelocks are judged at the slot of the block that contains the transaction, not at the highest slot already in the tree.
how: BLOCKS_DUMP=final/blocks_nodeN.json PQP_DUMP=final/pqp_nodeN.json cargo test verify_saved_tree -- --ignored (src/treechain/treechain_test.rs), with MINING_RATE/EXPECTED_TIME set to the run's values (config_used.json)
